comic-panel: A comic book page: halftone dots, speech bubbles and a POW! on the selection.
coral-reef: Underwater: light shafts, rising bubbles, aquarium tags and shell-shaped rows.
felt-table: A card table: green baize, the systems as a fanned hand of cards, a dealer's ledger.
neon-arcade: Synthwave: a neon sun and grid, arcade cabinets and a high-score table.
oak-bookshelf: A warm study: books on an oak shelf, a card-catalogue drawer and brass plates.
orbital-hud: A sci-fi cockpit: rings and brackets closing in on the selection, a mission log.
paper-notebook: Lined paper: sticky notes, a to-do list of games and a highlighter swipe.
phosphor-terminal: A green CRT shell: ls -l listings, a blinking cursor and a boot log on launch.
swiss-poster: Swiss typography: white, black and red, huge numbers and a red wipe.
vinyl-lounge: A night-time record shop: records sliding out of sleeves, a tracklist, the needle drop.
canvas: BananaOS's clean default: cards, a soft gradient and a games list.
classic: The classic BananaOS look: a framed picture over a row of cartridges.
hillside: A desktop from the early 2000s: windows, icons and a start bar.
turntable: Tiles and a turning record of systems, an example BananaOS ships.
